h:
（也适用于任何其他类型的风格转移，但我最初的兴趣是现实主义）

在我尝试现实主义模型的过程中，我总是感到失望，因为我永远无法获得我想要的创造力、差异和质量。

但在《Krea 2》中我发现了一些有趣的东西。我能够使用 Illustrious 或 Anima 等模型制作创意风格化图像，然后使用 Krea 2 对这些图像运行去噪 KSampler，以获得良好的逼真结果，同时总体上保留创意功能。

一旦你正确配置了所有内容，我发现输出看起来甚至比 Krea 2 仅通过提示生成的输出还要好。

（建议使用现实主义 LoRA 来帮助推动效果，因为 Krea 2 本身可能还不够。）

_________

在尝试优化手动提示工作流程时经历了很多挫折后，我发现工作流程的“自动”版本通常效果最好。视觉语言模型注入信息的方式似乎比手动提示能更好地传递理解。

手动提示或提示生成可以提供更强、更可控的风格转换，v1.​​1 工作流程就是为此而设置的。然而，提示这绝对是一件痛苦的事情，而且 Qwen3-4b 模型不是很强大，因此建议通过 ChatGPT 等服务或本地使用 llama.cpp 等程序使用更强大的模型（我一直在使用 Qwen3.8-27b，它似乎非常适合此目的）。

o.en:
(Also works for any other type of style transfer, but my initial interest was with realism)

In my time experimenting with realism models I've always been disappointed, as I could never get the sort of creativity, variance, and quality I wanted.

But with Krea 2 I've found something interesting. I'm able to make creative stylized images with a model like Illustrious or Anima, and then run a denoised KSampler over these with Krea 2 to get good realistic-looking results while generally retaining the creative features.

Once you get everything configured right I've found the outputs look even better than what Krea 2 is able to generate through prompting alone.

(It is recommended to use realism LoRAs to help push the effect, as Krea 2 might be insufficient by itself.)

_________

After a lot of frustration trying to optimize the manual prompting workflows, I've found the "automatic" version of the workflow generally works best. The way the vision language model injects the information seems to transfer the understanding better than manual prompting can.

Manual prompting or prompt generation can provide a stronger and more controlled style transfer, which the v1.1 workflow is set up for. However, this is an absolute pain to prompt for, and the Qwen3-4b model isn't very powerful, so it's recommended to use more powerful models through services like ChatGPT or locally with programs like llama.cpp (I've been using Qwen3.8-27b which seems to work well for this purpose).
